SEO_TITLE: Massive MIMO: The Antenna Revolution
FACT_HOOK: MIMO sounds complicated, but imagine hundreds of antennas working together to boost your signal. 5G uses Massive MIMO to revolutionize wireless communications.

In 5G, Massive MIMO arrays consist of dozens to hundreds of antennas on a single base station, sending and receiving multiple signals simultaneously. This increases network capacity, coverage, and efficiency. By directing beams to specific users, it reduces interference and enhances reliability.
